title: Payer Order on TRICARE Select Lines Reprocessed for Other Health Insurance
content:
**Basis.** What TRICARE would pay as primary payer on a **TRICARE Select** line reprocessed for other health insurance is the allowed amount times the attending share, less the beneficiary liability, never below zero. With other health insurance on file, the deductible and cost share of a line reprocessed for other health insurance are figured on the allowed amount net of the other insurer's payment, and where the other insurer paid on it TRICARE pays second: where the provider is non-network nonparticipating, TRICARE pays the lesser of what it would pay as primary payer and the charge the provider may bill the beneficiary (the billed amount, never more than the allowed amount plus the tier's balance-billing limit percentage) less the other insurer's payment, times the attending share, less the beneficiary liability; where the provider is participating, TRICARE pays the allowed amount less the other insurer's payment, times the attending share, less the beneficiary liability; otherwise TRICARE pays what it would pay as primary payer. Each figure is rounded to the cent and never below zero.

The balance-billing limit is 15 percent on every TRICARE Select tier. Billed amount, allowed amount, other insurer's payment and network relationship are read from the reversed line.

## Three outcomes

1. **Nonparticipating non-network provider, other insurer paid:** the lesser of the primary-payer amount and the billed amount (capped at the allowed amount plus 15 percent) less the other insurer's payment, times the attending share, less the liability.
2. **Participating provider, other insurer paid:** the allowed amount less the other insurer's payment, times the attending share, less the liability.
3. **Other insurer paid nothing, or no other health insurance on file:** the primary-payer amount.

## Hypothetical lines (attending share one, allowed amount 300.00, liability 0.00)

| Provider | Billed | Other insurer paid | TRICARE pays |
|---|---|---|---|
| participating | 320.00 | 180.00 | 120.00 |
| nonparticipating | 400.00 | 180.00 | the lesser of 300.00 and 345.00 less 180.00 (165.00): 165.00 |
| any | 320.00 | 0.00 | 300.00 |
